questions.q: In the beginning, what did God create?
questions.refText: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

questions.q: What did God form man from?
questions.refText: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

questions.q: How many of each clean animal did Noah take into the ark?
questions.refText: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

questions.q: What did the dove bring back to Noah in her mouth?
questions.refText: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

questions.q: Whom did God ask Abraham to offer as a burnt offering?
questions.refText: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

questions.q: What was counted to Abraham for righteousness?
questions.refText: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

questions.q: What did Moses see burning in the wilderness that was not consumed?
questions.refText: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

questions.q: What did Moses stretch out his hand over, so the waters were divided?
questions.refText: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

questions.q: What did David use to strike down Goliath?
questions.refText: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

questions.q: Who wrote, 'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want'?
questions.refText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

questions.q: Who shut the lions' mouths so they did not hurt Daniel?
questions.refText: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

questions.q: How many men did Nebuchadnezzar see walking loose in the fiery furnace?
questions.refText: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

questions.q: How long was Jonah in the belly of the great fish?
questions.refText: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

questions.q: How many days did Jonah say Nineveh had before it would be overthrown?
questions.refText: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

questions.q: Where did Mary lay the baby Jesus?
questions.refText: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

questions.q: What three gifts did the wise men present to Jesus?
questions.refText: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

questions.q: Where did Jesus turn water into wine, the beginning of his miracles?
questions.refText: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

options: Seven loaves and a few fishes
Five barley loaves and two small fishes
questions.q: What did the lad have that Jesus used to feed the multitude?
questions.refText: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

options: He sailed to the other side
questions.q: What did Jesus do on the sea in the fourth watch of the night?
questions.refText: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

questions.q: What did Jesus say he would make Peter and Andrew?
questions.refText: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

little.refText: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

little.q: Who was the first man God made?
little.refText: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

little.q: How many days did God take to make the heavens and the earth?
little.refText: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

little.q: Who was thrown into the lions' den?
little.refText: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

little.q: Who did the great fish swallow?
little.refText: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

little.q: What did the wise men follow to find Jesus?
little.refText: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

little.q: How many disciples did Jesus choose?
little.refText: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

little.q: Who was the strongest man in the Bible?
little.refText: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

little.q: What did Jesus ride when he came into Jerusalem?
little.refText: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
